summary: Regression-tested live Expo preview and public backend. Candidate mobile flow passed; backend auth, profile persistence, jobs, application, recruiter ranking, and ObjectId checks passed.
action_items: Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract, or explicitly document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as the supported key.
Add testID attributes to all interactive and critical informational React Native elements to make automated mobile regression reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the stated environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; deployment with only the required key will silently build API URLs with an empty base.
The frontend has no testID attributes on role cards, auth inputs/buttons, navigation, job cards, profile fields, or recruiter controls, contrary to the mobile testability requirement.
Backend logs show an earlier Pydantic serialization failure involving bson ObjectId; current regression responses contain no _id and the issue did not reproduce.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; used supplied credentials and existing records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview candidate login, feed/search, detail match display, back navigation, and profile navigation passed at 375x667. Recruiter API ranking passed; recruiter UI creation was not exercised in this iteration.
rca_of_issue: The configuration mismatch is in src/api.ts lines 48-50: it only checks EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (and an extra key of the same name), not the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL. This is latent with the current env but can break deployments using the documented variable.
